title: Reproduce taurine–HBD interaction-energy comparison
difficulty_reasons: Three 1:2 molecular complexes require conformer and binding-pose generation, deduplication, optimization, stationary-point validation, and counterpoise energies.
Published starting geometries and convergence details are absent, so coverage and method sensitivity must be justified independently.

paper.title: Separation of taurine and Na2SO4 via the in situ formation of deep eutectic solvents: experiments and computational simulation

data.description: Complete public chemical identity specification for Tau, Im, Gly (glycerol), MEA, charge, multiplicity, and 1:2 complex stoichiometry.

required_deliverables.description: Validated energies, candidate records, protocol, qualitative hypothesis test, ordering, and limitations.
